Library of earlier option surfaces with their realized Event Clock

Source: R/quiet.R
ec_quiet_library.Rd

Builds the candidate library for the ordinary-risk benchmark: one row per option surface with its at-the-money implied volatility, its smile shape relative to at-the-money, days to expiry, and its quietness — the Event Clock realized over the surface's own remaining life, from its valuation date to its expiry. A surface whose life saw little movement in the event probability carries little event learning in its smile, so quiet surfaces proxy for ordinary option risk.

Usage

ec_quiet_library(
  surfaces,
  x = NULL,
  method = "rv",
  interval = NULL,
  shape = c("difference", "ratio"),
  moneyness = c("log", "standardized"),
  atm_tol = 0.02,
  tz = "UTC",
  clip = NULL,
  trunc_sd = ec_default_params()$trunc_sd,
  scale_fn = stats::mad
)

Arguments

surfaces

A data.frame with one row per node and columns surface (identifier), date (valuation date, Date or POSIXct), expiry (Date or POSIXct), k (log-forward moneyness), iv (implied volatility); optional atm_iv (otherwise interpolated at \(k = 0\)), A (quietness), block (maturity block used for leave-block-out validation; default the expiry), and tau (time to expiry in years; default calendar days / 365). The output of cme_option_surfaces() can be passed as is.

x

Optional event_prices object for computing A.

method

Estimator for A (default "rv"; see event_clock()).

interval

Optional sampling interval in minutes for staggered grids (intraday x only).

shape

"difference" (default) or "ratio".

moneyness

"log" (default) or "standardized" (see Details).

atm_tol

Largest \(|k|\) of a node used as at-the-money when no nodes bracket \(k = 0\) (default 0.02).

tz

Time zone for calendar days to expiry and for Date bounds (default "UTC").

clip

Numeric length-2 clipping bounds for q before the log-odds transform; defaults to the bounds stored in x.

trunc_sd

Numeric, truncation threshold in robust standard deviations (default 3).

scale_fn

Function computing the robust scale of the increments for truncated (default stats::mad()).

Value

A tibble of class ec_quiet_library, one row per surface: surface, date, expiry, block, dte (calendar days to expiry), tau, atm_iv, A, A_complete, n_nodes, and nodes (a list-column of tibbles with k, z (standardized moneyness), iv, shape).

Details

Shape. With shape = "difference" the shape is \(\sigma(k) - \sigma_{ATM}\) (implied-volatility units); with "ratio" it is \(\sigma(k)/\sigma_{ATM}\). A target's own at-the-money quote later fixes only the level, so a target's wings never enter the benchmark.

Moneyness. With moneyness = "log" (default) shapes are compared at equal log-forward moneyness \(k\). With "standardized" they are compared at equal \(z = k / (\sigma_{ATM}\sqrt{\tau})\), the distance from the forward in at-the-money standard deviations. Standardized moneyness lines up surfaces of different maturities and volatility levels; it matters for low-volatility assets with short maturities, where a fixed log-moneyness band reaches far into the wings.

Quietness. If x is supplied, A is computed from the event-probability series over [valuation, expiry] of each surface: realized variation of the log-odds on the series' own observations (interval = NULL) or on staggered grids of interval minutes (as in event_clock_staggered()). Surfaces whose life extends beyond the last observation of x get A = NA (A_complete = FALSE). Alternatively, supply a column A in surfaces.

References

Hanke, Schadner, Stöckl, and Weissensteiner (Working Paper), "Learning Before Scheduled Events: Prediction Markets, State Prices, and Option Valuation".

See also

ec_quiet_rules(), ec_quiet_shape(), ec_quiet_select().

Examples

lib_nodes <- expand.grid(i = 1:4, k = c(-0.2, -0.1, 0, 0.1, 0.2))
lib_nodes$surface <- paste0("s", lib_nodes$i)
lib_nodes$date <- as.Date("2024-09-02") + 7 * (lib_nodes$i - 1)
lib_nodes$expiry <- lib_nodes$date + 4
lib_nodes$iv <- 0.5 + 0.8 * lib_nodes$k^2
lib_nodes$A <- c(0.01, 0.20, 0.02, 0.03)[lib_nodes$i]
ec_quiet_library(lib_nodes)
#> <ec_quiet_library> 4 surfaces, shape = difference, moneyness = log, A known for 4
#> # A tibble: 4 × 10
#>   surface date       expiry     block        dte    tau atm_iv     A A_complete
#>   <chr>   <date>     <date>     <chr>      <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl> <lgl>     
#> 1 s1      2024-09-02 2024-09-06 2024-09-06     4 0.0110    0.5  0.01 TRUE      
#> 2 s2      2024-09-09 2024-09-13 2024-09-13     4 0.0110    0.5  0.2  TRUE      
#> 3 s3      2024-09-16 2024-09-20 2024-09-20     4 0.0110    0.5  0.02 TRUE      
#> 4 s4      2024-09-23 2024-09-27 2024-09-27     4 0.0110    0.5  0.03 TRUE      
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: n_nodes <int>
